name: EPIC 211015239
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 4, 11.0 solar radii and 2.62 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 2,890 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 2.62 solar masses and 11.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,167 K at its surface.
